predictions: At first glance, last week looked kinda weak. And mathematically, my 17-10 record, while still decent, was indeed my 2nd worst week this season. But it was actually much better than it looks. EIGHT of my 10 incorrect picks gave up 13 or fewer points, I lost a shorthanded pick that took 13 slots, and I flat-out nailed the tiebreaker win in my match of the week pick. Oh well. I'm now at 209-84 (71.3% correct) so far.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Cheap Shots @ Down to F, Again. DTF is in the feature spot for a second straight week, as the race at the top of F has become an amazing three-legged beast. My question here is, how the heck is DTF in this fight with a losing singles record? Do they just mesh that well in doubles? I'll take the Cheapies, 14-10.

Match #2: (E Div.) Shooting Blanks @ What's the Point? With the Point falling for the first time last week, the Blanks' title chances have improved greatly. They still need to win here AND get some help from somebody else due to their point deficit, but at least now it's realistically possible. At least until this narrow loss... Point, 13-11.

Match #3: (A Div.) Appetite for Destruction @ Jonesing for Mugs. If Jonesing wins this one, they move within a win of clinching the A title. But if Appetite wins, the race becomes a much more open three- team slugfest. If Page is back, I think this might be Appetite, 13-11.
Match #4: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Sharky's Machine. Hello, new G leader! And now you get to face another of the four 6-win teams in a critical showdown. Machine nicks this again, 13-11.

Match #5: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Two Time. Two Time is a couple behind Death Throw, but they're also the team that just took out the Cheapies, making this race so dramatic. Two Time does it again, 13-11.
Match #6: (G Div.) Rippin Darts @ Fight Club. Absolutely nobody in G evidently wants to win this season title. Anybody who gets in front immediately tanks. Maybe it's Rippin that rebounds? 14-10.
Match #7: (H Div.) Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap) @ The Blonde Leading the Blind. Both of these teams are fresh off big upsets, and are looking to continue that win streak. Let's make it Dirty, 14-10.

Match #8: (G Div.) Banging the Wire @ Aim-ing For Trouble. The stuff I wrote for match #6. Copy/paste here, but in this one it's the Bangers trying to right the ship. I think they do, but barely, 13-11.
Match #9: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Son of a Beach. It might take 5 wins to lock up a top-four-in-the-league finish, but it will surely take at least 4. Huge matchup in that messy battle. Darty, 13-11.

Match #10: (C Div.) Mulligans Mafia @ Projectile Dysfunction. At first pass, this looks like a battle for 4th. But there might be time for the winner to make a run at 2nd place. Let's take Mafia, 13-11.
Match #11: (D Div.) The Bullies @ Double In Stumble Out. The quest to avoid a bottom-two spot (and a likely drop to E) is in full form here. Stumble won a tiebreaker last time. They do it again.
Match #12: (E Div.) Main St Mayhem @ Outlaw Arrows. Three teams in E are in an almost dead-heat in the race to avoid a bottom-2 finish. This matchup is drama incarnate. Mayhem prevails, 15-9.
